description:
ACES-STAR, the relaunched Erasmus Mundus master in aquaculture, environment and society, is delivered from three centres of excellence — Scotland, Crete and France — coordinated through SAMS. Scholarship rounds in recent cycles have closed between late January and late February, with the 2027 dates posted on the official site.

Programme Highlights

  • Three-centre aquaculture training: Scotland, Greece and France
  • Scholarship package of about EUR 1,400/month plus tuition
  • Record application volumes in recent editions — apply early in the window
  • Graduates enter aquaculture industry, research and food-security organisations

Who Should Apply

Marine biology, aquaculture, biology and environmental graduates are the core applicants, with a strong interest in sustainable seafood systems.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarship: around EUR 1,400 monthly for 24 months plus tuition and insurance for selected students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Monitor the EMM-ACES website for the 2027 application window and prepare references early given the programme's popularity. Key deadline information: ACES-STAR scholarship rounds typically close in late January/February — 2027 dates announced on the official site.
